Type":1,"content":"笑殺拘泥都一般。若能勘破個中理，妙用本來向一體。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452545264140327"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽相見兩為難，一山一水何足言。二十四山雙雙起，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"少有時師通此義。五行分布二十四，時師此訣何曾記。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"山上龍神不下水，水裏龍神不上山。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"25","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"用此量山與步水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"百里江山一餉間。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"更有淨隂淨陽法，前後八尺不宜雜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"28","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"斜正受來隂陽取，氣乗生旺方無煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"29","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"來處起頂須要知，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"三節四節不須拘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"只要龍神得生旺，隂陽却與穴中殊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"天上星辰似織羅，水交三八要相過。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"水發城門須要會，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"却如湖裏雁交鵝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"穴上明堂幷朝水，文庫大小俱得位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452545146765338"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"截定生旺莫教流，直射直流家業退。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"38","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"射破生方定少，亾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"冲破旺位財狼璫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"40","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"文若來時男女亂，庫方來到定為殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"生出剋出名為退，生入剋入名為進。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"42","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"退水宜流千百步，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"進水須教庭户迎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"進退得位出公卿，家資巨富旺人丁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"旺方帶煞來不宜，庫中藏煞去亦非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"更看諸位高峰起，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"尖秀方圓須得位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"48","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"生方高聳旺人丁，官旺起峰官禄生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"49","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"水中消息少知音，却向元空裏面尋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"50","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"坐向須明生剋化，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"進退水路總非輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"四金四木竝八水，四火四土少五行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452587647385636"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"大小盡在元空裏，二十四山有水神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"十個退神靈如鬼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"十四進神如鬼靈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"生入剋入為進神，生出剋出為退神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"58","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"進神宜進家資旺，若還退時家不興。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"59","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"退神宜退亦同旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"若還進時主官刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"溝壑明堂定方隅，便從品折自縈紆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"四尺八寸為一歩，折取須交向所宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"63","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"小神須要入中神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"中神流入大神位。三折更上御街去，一舉登科名冠世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"竒貴貪狼并禄馬，三合聨珠貴無價。凶神流短吉神長，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴聲名滿天下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉號衙廳，神壇寺觀亦能興。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452548418109449"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"內有旗鎗紅門水，雷公館位使人驚。水神禍福原非細，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"更須一一查公位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"74","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴貧賤在水神，水是山家血脉精。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"山静水動晝夜定，水主財禄山人丁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤艮㢲號御街，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"四大尊神在內排。生剋須憑五行布，要識天機元妙處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":4,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公養老看雌雄，天下諸書對不同。先看金龍動不動，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":5,"lineType":1,"content":"次察血脉認來龍。龍分兩片隂陽取，水對三义細認踪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":6,"lineType":1,"content":"江南龍來江北望，江西龍去望江東。是以聖人卜河洛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"瀍澗二水交華嵩。相其隂陽流水位，卜年卜宅世都宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"晉世景純傳此術，演經立義出元空。朱雀發源生旺氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"一一講説開愚䝉。一生二兮二生三，三生萬物是元闗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352282791919679"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"山管山兮水管水，此是隂陽不待言。識得隂陽元妙理，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"知其衰旺生與死。不問坐山與來水，但逢死氣皆無取。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"先天羅經十二支，後天再用干與維。八干四維輔正位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"子母公孫同此推。二十四山分順逆，共成四十有八局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"五行即在此中分，祖宗却從隂陽出。陽從左邊團團轉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"隂從右路轉相通。有人識得隂陽者，何從大地不相逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"陽山陽向水流陽，執定此説甚荒唐。隂山隂向水流隂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"笑殺拘泥都一般。若能勘破個中理，妙用本來向一體。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352282791936063"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽相見兩為難，一山一水何足言。二十四山雙雙起，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"少有時師通此義。五行分布二十四，時師此訣何曽記。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"山上龍神不下水，水裏龍神不上山。用此量山與歩水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"百里江山一餉間。更有淨隂淨陽法，前後八尺不宜雜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"斜正受來隂陽取，氣乗生旺方無煞。來處起頂須要知，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"三節四節不須拘，只要龍神得生旺，隂陽却與穴中殊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"天上星辰似織羅，水交三八要相過，水發城門須要㑹，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"却如湖裏雁交鵝。穴上明堂并朝水，文庫大小俱得位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352282791952447"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"截定生旺莫教流，直射直流家業退。射破生方定少亾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"冲破旺位財狼□。文若來時男女亂，庫方來到定為殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"生出剋出名為退，生入剋入名為進，退水宜流千百歩，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"進水須教庭户迎，進退得位出公卿，家資巨富旺人丁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"旺方帯煞來不宜，庫中蔵煞去亦非。更看諸位髙峰起，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"尖秀方圓須得位，生方髙聳旺人丁，官旺起峰官禄生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"水中消息少知音，却向元空裏面尋。坐向須明生剋化，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"進退水路總非輕。四金四木竝八水，四火四土少五行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352282791968831"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"大小盡在元空裏，二十四山有水神。十個退神靈如鬼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"十四進神如鬼靈。生入剋入為進神，生出剋出為退神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"進神宜進家資旺，若還退時家不興。退神宜退亦同旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"若還進時主官刑。溝壑明堂定方隅，便從品折自縈紆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"四尺八寸為一歩，折取須交向所宜。小神須要入中神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"中神流入大神位。三折更上御街去，一舉登科名冠世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"竒貴貪狼并禄馬，三合聨珠貴無價。凶神流短吉神長，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴聲名滿天下。子午卯酉號衙㕔，神壇寺觀亦能興。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352282791985215"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"内有旗鎗紅門水，雷公館位使人驚。水神禍福原非細，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"更須一一查公位。乾坤艮㢲長男興，寅申巳亥長伶仃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"甲庚丙𡈼中男發，子午卯酉中男殺。乙辛丁癸小男强，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未小男殃。富貴貧賤在水神，水是山家血脉精。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"山静水動晝夜定，水主財禄山人丁。乾坤艮㢲號御街，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"四大尊神在内排。生剋須慿五行布，要識天機元妙處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤艮㢲水長流，吉神先入家豪富。請騐一家舊日墳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":54,"lineType":1,"content":"十墳埋下九墳貧。惟有一墳能發福，去水來山盡合情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352282792001599"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"宗廟本是隂陽元，得四失六難為全；三才六建雖為妙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"得三失五盡為偏。葢因一行擾外國，遂把五行顛倒徧；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"以訛傳訛竟不明，所以禍福為錯亂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352282792017983"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"青嚢序","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
